import re,html,pathlib
t=pathlib.Path('products/research/translation-test/tcafe-jobs.html').read_text(errors='replace')
print(len(t))
t2=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>|<style.*?</style>','',t,flags=re.S)
tx=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','\n',t2))
tx=re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+','\n',tx)
out=tx[:9000]
print(out)
links=sorted(set(re.findall(r'href="([^"]*(?:Job|job)[^"]*)"',t)))[:60]
print('\n'.join(links))
